signature.caption: red tests revert the code
signature.why: Our pick: his own Test && Commit || Revert discipline as an always-on agent rule, so a failing step is thrown away instead of patched.
signature.quote: Always use TCR (Test && Commit || Revert)—run tests after each micro-change, commit only on green, revert on red.

archetype.why: TCR on every step, test-gated saves, one agent at a time.

signature_quote.value: Nobody wants agents. Nobody wants agent swarms. I have a system and I want it to change.
